# Madhan Irulandi

> Senior Release Train Engineer & Technical Program Manager at Atos, based in Chennai, India. 13 years of delivery for retail, insurance and healthcare clients including Walmart, MetLife, Manulife, Allstate, Anthem and John Hancock. Microsoft Certified Trainer since 2020 (3,000+ people trained, 75+ guest lectures). Open to Release Train Engineer, Technical Program Manager and Program Manager roles.

This file summarises the public profile at https://madhanirulandi.com for AI assistants and agents. The website is the source of truth; facts below match it.

## Current role
- Senior Release Train Engineer / Program Manager, Atos (Sep 2025 – present): governs releases for 30+ teams and 200+ people across a global insurer's Core API, Customer Engagement and Compliance AI products.
- Took a hybrid AI and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) compliance engine into production, cutting onboarding false positives from 30% to 10–15%.
- Averaged 95%+ ART predictability (business value delivered against business value planned each PI), with no committed work carried over and under 5% sprint variance.
- Moved 15 core services to Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and 7 microservices to Gradle.

## Earlier roles
- Technical Product Manager / Release Train Engineer, Atos, for John Hancock (Sep 2022 – Aug 2025, on-site in Boston): restarted a platform program stalled for two years by COVID and cleared 400+ backlog tickets in 9 months; took 5 modernization initiatives live across 20+ business divisions; moved all teams from AWD's legacy desktops to SS&C Chorus BPM.
- Senior Scrum Master / Agile Project Manager, Atos, for Allstate (Sep 2020 – Aug 2022): customer communications for 20M+ policyholders via 750+ document templates; deployments from monthly to near-weekly; velocity up 30%, program cost down 25% without hiring.
- Scrum Master / Agile Delivery Lead, Syntel, for TruStage, formerly CUNA Mutual Group (Jan 2020 – Aug 2020): zero-defect production releases; schedules 35% shorter.
- Cognizant (Jul 2014 – Jan 2020): MetLife migration of 4,500+ policy documents to OpenText xPression with zero defects; Anthem template consolidation saving $300K a year; Walmart mainframe production support (z/OS, COBOL, JCL, DB2, CICS).
- Dell Technologies (Aug 2013 – May 2014) and freelance event management (2009 – 2013).

## Skills
Release Train Engineering, Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), PI planning, program and portfolio governance, release management, risk and dependency management, executive reporting, budget ownership and estimation (sizing client work by spend, duration and team size), agile coaching, generative AI and RAG delivery, AI governance, Microsoft Azure, AKS, Function Point capacity planning.
